authoring_history.prompt: Create a complete production 2D isometric RPG animation atlas STRICTLY based on the specified ORIGINAL character in the attached reference. EXACTLY EIGHT COLUMNS and THIRTEEN ROWS = 104 separate whole articulated poses. Each complete character must occupy at most 50 percent of cell width and height. Leave large fully transparent gutters at least 25 pixels all around each pose and outer border, never touch neighbors or crop body. Exact column direction order E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE. E strict right profile, SE front-right, S DIRECT FRONT toward viewer, SW front-left, W strict left profile, NW back-left, N FULL BACK no face visible, NE back-right. Retain these compass views in every action. Rows exactly: 1 neutral idle; 2 visibly different breathing idle; 3 locomotion phase one; 4 locomotion phase two; 5 locomotion phase three; 6 attack windup; 7 attack CONTACT in facing direction; 8 attack recovery; 9 hit recoil; 10 hit recovery; 11 death begins; 12 falling close to ground; 13 final flat collapsed recognizable body. All 104 poses must be physically articulated and distinct, not repeated or merely translated. Keep body scale consistent throughout. No captions, grid lines, scenes, cast shadows or disconnected particles. The ONLY reference character to animate is the sand worm in BOTTOM ROW, RIGHTMOST COLUMN of the attached 4-by-4 original character atlas, pixel region x=984 y=899 width=328 height=300 in the 1312x1199 image. Do NOT include or borrow anatomy from any other character. Preserve that beige/brown annulated worm with segmented ridges, small dorsal spines, and a huge circular red-brown tooth-lined opening at the front end. No limbs, eyes, weapons, armor or humanoid parts. Its long thick lower body remains partially emerged from a small connected beige rock base, as in the original, and bends to face each direction. The N column shows the convex BACK of the head and ridged back, no front-facing mouth. S shows circular mouth facing directly toward viewer. Movement is real worm undulation with different contractions, raised head and segment bends, not sliding stills. Attack winds head back, lunges the wide tooth-lined mouth forward, then recoils; the same contact pose can align with the game's existing radial slam. Hit recoils neck/body, death bends, buckles and ends with collapsed body and mouth against the ground. No disconnected dust or rocks. Keep each full connected silhouette inside its cell.
